Sun, August 9, 2026 at 6:03 AM PDT 7 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in Universal Technical Institute Inc? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • Third-quarter results improved: Revenue rose 7.2% year over year to $218.9 million, while average active students increased 5.8% and new starts climbed 10.9% to 6,342. Concorde revenue grew 11.1%, and UTI starts increased 23%.

  • Fiscal 2026 guidance was reduced because UTI's high school auto-diesel starts are tracking below expectations and students are shifting faster toward shorter skilled-trades programs, which generate less revenue and profit per student. Management attributed about 70% of the baseline adjusted EBITDA reduction to the high school shortfall and 30% to the program mix shift.

  • Expansion remains a long-term focus: UTI plans additional campuses in Salt Lake City, Houston and Phoenix, raised expected fiscal-year capital spending to about $110 million, and reiterated its fiscal 2029 targets of more than $1.2 billion in revenue and adjusted EBITDA approaching $220 million.

Universal Technical Institute (NYSE:UTI) reported higher third-quarter revenue, student enrollment and new student starts, while lowering its fiscal 2026 outlook to reflect softer-than-expected fourth-quarter starts from its UTI division's high school channel and a faster-than-anticipated shift toward shorter skilled-trades programs.

Revenue rose 7.2% year over year to $218.9 million in the fiscal third quarter, supported by enrollment growth across the company's UTI and Concorde divisions. Consolidated net income was $2.3 million, or $0.04 per diluted share. Baseline adjusted EBITDA totaled $27.2 million, while reported adjusted EBITDA was $18.2 million after $9 million of strategic growth investments.

→ No Hangover: Revisiting Microsoft One Week After Earnings

"The third quarter was another strong quarter for Universal Technical Institute and reinforces our confidence in both the environment for job demand for our students as well as student interest in our program offerings," CEO Jerome Grant said.

Enrollment Growth Led by UTI Starts

Total average full-time active students increased 5.8% to 25,131, while new student starts rose 10.9% to 6,342. The UTI division drove much of the starts increase, with starts up 23% year over year, according to Grant. UTI average active students increased 4%, while Concorde average active students increased 8.5%, helped by demand in dental programs.

→ MarketBeat Week in Review – 08/03 - 08/07

Concorde starts were softer during the quarter because of fewer clinical starts compared with the prior-year period, CFO Bruce Schuman said. He noted that start timing can vary based on academic calendars and program cohort schedules and that the effect had been included in the company's prior outlook.

要点

  • 对环球技术学院感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • 第三季度业绩有所改善：收入同比增长 7.2% 至 2.189 亿美元，平均活跃学生人数增长 5.8%，新入学人数增长 10.9% 至 6,342 人。 协和式飞机收入增长 11.1%，UTI 开工量增长 23%。
  • 2026 财年指导方针被下调，因为 UTI 的高中汽车柴油机开工率低于预期，而且学生们正在更快地转向较短的技术行业项目，这些项目为每个学生带来的收入和利润较少。 管理层将基线调整后 EBITDA 减少的 70% 归因于高中教育短缺，30% 归因于项目组合转变。
  • 扩张仍然是一个长期关注点：UTI计划在盐湖城、休斯顿和菲尼克斯增设校区，将预期财年资本支出提高至约1.1亿美元，并重申其2029财年收入超过12亿美元的目标，调整后的EBITDA接近2.2亿美元。

环球技术学院 (NYSE:UTI) 报告称，第三季度收入、学生入学率和新生开学率均有所上升，同时下调了 2026 财年展望，以反映其 UTI 部门高中渠道第四季度开学率低于预期，以及向时间较短的技术行业项目的转变速度快于预期。

得益于公司 UTI 和 Concorde 部门的入学人数增长，第三财季收入同比增长 7.2% 至 2.189 亿美元。 合并净利润为 230 万美元，即稀释后每股收益 0.04 美元。 基线调整后 EBITDA 总计 2720 万美元，而报告的调整后 EBITDA 在 900 万美元战略增长投资后为 1820 万美元。

→ 没有后遗症：财报发布一周后重温微软

首席执行官杰罗姆·格兰特 (Jerome Grant) 表示：“第三季度是环球技术学院又一个强劲的季度，增强了我们对学生就业需求环境以及学生对我们课程的兴趣的信心。”

UTI 引领的入学人数增长开始

平均全日制在校学生总数增长 5.8%，达到 25,131 人，新生入学人数增长 10.9%，达到 6,342 人。 格兰特表示，UTI 部门推动了开工率的增长，开工率同比增长 23%。 在牙科项目需求的推动下，UTI 平均活跃学生人数增加了 4%，而 Concorde 平均活跃学生人数增加了 8.5%。

→ MarketBeat 周回顾 – 08/03 - 08/07

首席财务官布鲁斯·舒曼 (Bruce Schuman) 表示，本季度协和式飞机的开工量较去年同期有所减少，因为临床开工量较少。 他指出，开始时间可能会根据学术日历和项目队列时间表而有所不同，并且该影响已包含在公司之前的展望中。
